hints.tr: Kalıpta grup varsa `findall` yalnızca grubu verir: `r"#(\w+)"`.
hints.en: If the pattern has a group, `findall` gives only the group: `r"#(\w+)"`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import re

post = input("Post: ")

for tag in re.findall(r"#(\w+)", post):
    print(tag.lower())
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import re

post = input("Post: ")

for tag in re.findall(r"#(\w+)", post):
    print(tag.lower())
```
